template: Time Profiler + Points of Interest; app-scoped native launch, no SwiftUI layout tracing. Separate from unprofiled timings.
method: Five exact Reveal page signposts through+180ms per capture. Actual sample weights; stackless samples count in CPU totals. Inclusive regions overlap. Longest callback gaps aligned by raw uptime offsets; not all longest gaps lie in the180ms scope.
limits: Three captures each for original-row and row-overlays; one corroborating screen each for other controls.
Generic graph/layout stacks do not identify a specific source modifier or child.
Named user functions may be inlined; little sampled CPU does not prove zero total cost.
Callbacks are scheduling observations, not presented frames. Background work can compete for CPU.
Time Profiler provides no SwiftUI view/cause graph; previous SwiftUI captures had no such data.
